High-level: Sandpiper builds a low-latency personalization and ranking layer for live content feeds. Very latency- and cost-sensitive: reads A/B test show revenue drop if P99 > 50ms. CTO wants <30ms P50 and P99 under 80ms for 512-token chat/rerank flows.

Interests / asks: batching/caching/quantization to reduce token cost; automated suggestions from Redwood Optimize; dedicated pools for steady-state throughput with burst to hosted; on-prem option later for regulated customers. Explicit ask: Redwood to run a perf benchmark vs their current Triton/FP16 self-hosted stack at ~800 qps baseline and 3 traffic mixes (chat short, rerank mid, long-summary). Want comparisons for FP16, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantized variants including latency percentiles, throughput, and per-token cost estimates.

Security/compliance: need SSO (SAML) + SCIM, SOC2 evidence, audit logs retention = 12 months minimum, optional KMS integration for customer keys, and US data residency today with EU residency required for EU customers later.

Quotes: CTO Ana Morales: "If Redwood can match our latency at 30ms median while cutting cost 30% we'd seriously consider Dedicated with a 12–24 month commit."

Operational notes: product team already has small internal benchmark harness (JMeter+grpc) and will provide traffic profiles. They prefer Redwood to run a canonical run and share raw traces (or Firehose) for comparison. Typical payloads: user context ~80 tokens + item descriptions ~120 tokens. KV cache hit expected ~35% on personalization paths.

POC constraints: must not use customer PII in public test runs; sandbox data will be supplied. Legal: DPA review in progress (blocker).

Sales shorthand: mid-market, high upside (enterprise expansion into regulated customers), timeline Q2 close if benchmarks look good.
